text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: W-what's wrong all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Look, Trainer. That's exactly what I've 
been searching for!"
choice_data_list_en: Wh-What's gotten into you all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Epiphaneia 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies in the likeness of 
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Did you want a Paka Petit?
Did you want a Paka Petit?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's not so much about the Paka Petit 
itself; I just wanted something that fits 
my room's decor.
choice_data_list: ぱかプチが欲しかったのか？
ぱかプチが欲しかったの？
choice_data_list_en: So you wanted a Paka Puchi?
So you wanted a Paka Puchi?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And that was those Paka Petit figures! The 
moment I laid eyes on them, a spark hit 
me—this is it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, every single one is great. There's 
no way I can choose!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm bringing everyone home! Even 
if it takes every last bit of my 
allowance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the momentum really caught 
fire. At this rate, it doesn't look like 
she'll settle down until her money or Paka 
Pouch runs completely dry.
choice_data_list: ...Would you let me take this one?
...Could you let me take this one?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: ……ここは俺に取らせてくれないか？
……ここは私に取らせてくれない？
choice_data_list_en: ...Could you let me take care of this one?
...Would you let me take care of this one?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, how reassuring! Alright, let's see 
what you can do!"
choice_data_list_en: I need you to trust me.
I want you to believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
